text:
Las strands that I gathered in ties of gold

with arte vuestra blanca and tierna mano,

mandraba, and el semblante altivo and plain

and la florida light that amando adgold.


Creía in vos ofl sacro excelso cgold

that el esplindor se unía sobwasno;

forthat in sombra, aunthat bella, and traje humano

no sawo such biin el orbe and such tesgold.


whin rompiste leda el sweet espanto,

that of vos parte absint and alone apina,

preguntando: «¿Qué force me arrebata?»


I, that temo partirme, suelto in weeping,

digo: «Piinso that a ofath me withofna

ofl cruel Iur love la saña ingrata».

translation.title: Las strands that I gathered in ties of gold
